licenseFindings: Bundled LICENSE is the NVIDIA Software License Agreement and CUDA Supplement
Attachment A lists the CUDA BLAS Library (Windows cublas.dll, cublasLt.dll, including versioned file names) as distributable with applications developed by the licensee
Distribution requirements include material additional functionality beyond the SDK and that distributable portions are accessed only by the licensee's application
The agreement states it binds whoever downloads or uses the software; whether an app-initiated end-user download from NVIDIA fits the distribution grant is not resolved here and needs review
limitations: MSVC runtime and OpenMP loaded from System32 because this machine has the VC++ 14.51 redistributable installed; a clean machine is still untested

Isolation used PATH, not the full-path loading MOD-015 requires: the executable's folder and System32 precede PATH, so a planted cublas64_13.dll there would win. The Phase 3 worker must control DLL search (for example SetDefaultDllDirectories plus AddDllDirectory before a runtime-loaded ggml CUDA backend)
Driver-provided CUDA components (nvcuda, nvcudart_hybrid64, nvapi) load from the NVIDIA driver store, as expected for the machine prerequisite
